rows.title: Saquon Barkley: Won't return Sunday
rows.headline: Won't return Sunday
rows.blurb: Barkley (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Rams, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

rows.title: Kyle Monangai: Tending to thumb issue
rows.headline: Tending to thumb issue
rows.blurb: Coach Ben Johnson said after Sunday's 23-12 win against the Jets that Monangai suffered a thumb injury during the contest, Kevin Fishbain of The Athletic reports.

rows.title: Kyren Williams: Two late TDs in comeback win
rows.headline: Two late TDs in comeback win
rows.blurb: Williams rushed 16 times for 80 yards and two touchdowns while catching 10 of 13 targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Eagles.

rows.title: Lamar Jackson: Donning walking boot
rows.headline: Donning walking boot
rows.blurb: Jackson (ankle) was seen wearing a walking boot on his left foot after Sunday's 24-18 victory against the Titans, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

rows.title: Tee Higgins: Suffers adductor injury in Week 4
rows.headline: Suffers adductor injury in Week 4
rows.blurb: Higgins sustained an adductor issue during Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jaguars, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

rows.title: Puka Nacua: Nine catches, rushing TD in return
rows.headline: Nine catches, rushing TD in return
rows.blurb: Nacua (hip) caught nine of 12 targets for 125 yards and added a two-yard rushing touchdown in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Eagles.

rows.title: Lamar Jackson: Minter optimistic about ankle injury
rows.headline: Minter optimistic about ankle injury
rows.blurb: Head coach Jesse Minter said after Sunday's 24-18 win versus the the Titans that the Ravens are optimistic about the ankle issue that he suffered in the first half of the game, Jonas Shaffer of TheBaltimoreBanner.com reports.

rows.title: Lamar Jackson: Suffers ankle injury in Week 4
rows.headline: Suffers ankle injury in Week 4
rows.blurb: Jackson sustained an ankle injury during Sunday's game against the Titans, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

rows.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Won't return vs. Jacksonville
rows.headline: Won't return vs. Jacksonville
rows.blurb: Chase (concussion) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

rows.title: Josh Allen: Two total TDs in loss
rows.headline: Two total TDs in loss
rows.blurb: Allen completed 23 of 33 passes for 253 yards with a touchdown and an interception and added five carries for four yards and another score in the Bills' 29-26 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

rows.title: Dak Prescott: Rides Lamb to comeback win
rows.headline: Rides Lamb to comeback win
rows.blurb: Prescott completed 32 of 45 passes for 335 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans. He added seven yards on two carries.

rows.title: James Cook: Highly efficient with 12 carries
rows.headline: Highly efficient with 12 carries
rows.blurb: Cook rushed 12 times for 75 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for eight yards in the Bills' 29-26 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

rows.title: Chase Brown: Massive production as receiver
rows.headline: Massive production as receiver
rows.blurb: Brown rushed nine times for 10 yards and brought in all 11 targets for 71 yards in the Bengals' 22-17 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.

rows.title: George Pickens: Two long gains in win over Houston
rows.headline: Two long gains in win over Houston
rows.blurb: Pickens caught two of three targets for 75 yards in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans.

rows.title: Tyson Bagent: No TDs in Week 4 win
rows.headline: No TDs in Week 4 win
rows.blurb: Bagent completed 25 of 34 passes for 268 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 23-12 win over the Jets. He also rushed four times for one yard.

rows.title: Javonte Williams: Makes three trips to end zone in Week 4 win
rows.headline: Makes three trips to end zone in Week 4 win
rows.blurb: Williams carried the ball 19 times for 62 yards and three touchdowns while catching all five of his targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans.

rows.title: CeeDee Lamb: Historic day in comeback win
rows.headline: Historic day in comeback win
rows.blurb: Lamb caught 17 of 21 targets for 189 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-30 win over the Texans.

rows.title: Jalen Hurts: Modest numbers without top targets
rows.headline: Modest numbers without top targets
rows.blurb: Hurts completed 12 of 27 passes for 93 yards and two touchdowns while rushing five times for 18 yards in Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Rams.

rows.title: Matthew Stafford: Overcomes two INTs in comeback win
rows.headline: Overcomes two INTs in comeback win
rows.blurb: Stafford completed 32 of 51 passes for 317 yards, no touchdowns and two interceptions in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Eagles. He also rushed three times for 10 yards.

rows.title: Davante Adams: Quiet in Nacua's return
rows.headline: Quiet in Nacua's return
rows.blurb: Adams caught four of nine targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Eagles.

rows.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Good production with 19 touches
rows.headline: Good production with 19 touches
rows.blurb: Tuten rushed 17 times for 73 yards and brought in both targets for 18 yards in the Jaguars' 22-17 win over the Bengals on Sunday.

rows.title: Rashee Rice: Suffers hamstring injury
rows.headline: Suffers hamstring injury
rows.blurb: Rice officially sustained a hamstring injury during Sunday's contest at Las Vegas.

rows.title: Joe Burrow: Stellar numbers in Week 4 loss
rows.headline: Stellar numbers in Week 4 loss
rows.blurb: Burrow completed 39 of 54 passes for 428 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions while rushing three times for six yards and another score in the Bengals' 22-17 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also committed a fumble recovered by Cincinnati.

rows.title: Rashee Rice: Departs Sunday's contest
rows.headline: Departs Sunday's contest
rows.blurb: Rice suffered an apparent hamstring injury during Sunday's game in Las Vegas, James Palmer of Bleacher Report reports.

rows.title: Bucky Irving: Modest production with 16 carries
rows.headline: Modest production with 16 carries
rows.blurb: Irving rushed 16 times for 61 yards in the Buccaneers' 17-14 loss to the Packers on Sunday.

rows.title: D'Andre Swift: Outplayed by Monangai in Week 4
rows.headline: Outplayed by Monangai in Week 4
rows.blurb: Swift rushed 15 times for 58 yards and caught both of his targets for 16 yards in Sunday's 23-12 win over the Jets. He also lost a fumble.

rows.title: Stefon Diggs: Team-high five grabs in Week 4 loss
rows.headline: Team-high five grabs in Week 4 loss
rows.blurb: Diggs caught five of nine targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts.

rows.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Held in check by Indy
rows.headline: Held in check by Indy
rows.blurb: Croskey-Merritt carried the ball nine times for a season-low 15 yards and caught two of four targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts.

rows.title: Athan Kaliakmanis: Sees first NFL action in Week 4 loss
rows.headline: Sees first NFL action in Week 4 loss
rows.blurb: Kaliakmanis completed 15 of 33 passes for 186 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts. He added 16 yards on three carries.

rows.title: Daniel Jones: Shrugs off early turnovers in win
rows.headline: Shrugs off early turnovers in win
rows.blurb: Jones completed 19 of 34 passes for 143 yards and an interception in Sunday's 30-13 win over the Commanders. He added two yards and a rushing touchdown on four carries while committing a fumble.

rows.title: Mike Evans: Cleared to play Week 4
rows.headline: Cleared to play Week 4
rows.blurb: Evans (ribs) is active for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

rows.title: Mack Hollins: Exits game with calf injury
rows.headline: Exits game with calf injury
rows.blurb: Hollins (calf) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Bills.

rows.title: Ladd McConkey: Suiting up in Week 4
rows.headline: Suiting up in Week 4
rows.blurb: McConkey (foot) is active for Sunday's game at Seattle, Eric Smith of the Chargers' official site reports.

rows.title: DJ Moore: Return in doubt in Week 4
rows.headline: Return in doubt in Week 4
rows.blurb: Moore (shoulder) is considered doubtful to return to Sunday's contest versus the Patriots.

rows.title: DJ Moore: Dealing with shoulder injury Sunday
rows.headline: Dealing with shoulder injury Sunday
rows.blurb: Moore departed Sunday's contest against the Patriots due to a shoulder injury.
